title: npm and node:test
description: A plain Node.js project (ESM, no build step) checked with `npm run check` (syntax, unit tests with node:test, coverage thresholds). A pull request may not change the scripts or engines in package.json or the repository's own scripts, and the numbers in coverage.thresholds.json may only go up.
choose: The project is installed with npm and tested with the test runner built into Node, with no build step.
